learning: Speed reduction to 1.4 raised oval progress (0.115 to 0.242) but did not clear the s-bend and slalom line losses. Forward-row losses persist with ±0.055 and ±0.06 spans at y=0.045 to 0.06.
notes: Iteration 9 geometry and controller carried over unchanged, so the race measures the Integrator's controller on the best-measured platform. No controller change was made because no tested gain has moved the max_error floor or cleared the forward-row line losses.
rationale: This is the final iteration, so I keep the Builder's geometry exactly as proposed, which matches iteration 9: sensors at y=0.045 with x=±0.055 and 16 mm footprints, a 0.12 m track, 0.035 m wheels, 0.6 kg, and a 0.16 x 0.12 m body. Iteration 9 is the best measured platform (score 67.70). Its controller (base_speed 1.4, kp 2.5, ki 0.5, kd 0.15, weights [-2,-1,0,1,2], last_direction) is kept unchanged, so the race measures this controller on this platform. The remaining line losses (0.9 on s-bend, 1.0 on slalom) did not clear when base_speed went from 1.6 to 1.4 in iteration 9, so speed is not their cause. Iteration 6 showed that the forward row is the source, and every gain change tried has left the max_error floor near 0.060 to 0.063. Any new untested gain would be a gamble on the final race, so I make no change. I expect results near iteration 9 on the development tracks, with the unseen track uncertain.
